## Türk Ailelerin En Çok Sorduğu Sorular

          
            

## Hangi ülkedeki uluslararası eğitim en uygun fiyatlı?

            Uluslararası eğitimde en uygun ücretler genellikle Almanya ve Hollanda'daki devlet okullarında görülmektedir. Özel uluslararası okullar arasında Almanya ve İtalya'daki seçenekler Dubai veya Londra'ya kıyasla daha erişilebilir ücretler sunabilmektedir.

          
          
            

## Dubai ve İngiltere uluslararası okul ücretleri nasıl karşılaştırılır?

            Dubai'de yıllık öğretim ücreti 25.000-120.000 AED (6.800-32.700 USD) arasında değişirken, Londra'daki bağımsız okullarda yıllık ücretler 15.000-45.000 GBP (19.000-57.000 USD) seviyelerine ulaşabilmektedir. Yaşam maliyeti dahil edildiğinde Londra genel olarak daha pahalıdır.

          
          
            

## Yurt dışı eğitim maliyetini düşürmenin yolları var mı?

            Yurt dışı eğitim maliyetini azaltmak için burs ve finansal yardım başvuruları, işveren eğitim katkısı (education allowance), devlet okullarının tercih edilmesi ve erken başvuru indirimleri değerlendirilebilir. IB ve A-Level okullarının çoğu akademik başarı bursu sunmaktadır. Ayrıca bağımsız okul danışmanlığı sürecinde bütçenize uygun alternatifler de belirlenebilir.

          
          
            

## Yurt dışı eğitimde gizli maliyetler neler?

            Okul ücretinin ötesinde gizli maliyetler arasında tek seferlik kayıt ve başvuru ücretleri, üniforma ve okul materyalleri, okul servisi veya toplu taşıma abonelikleri, okul gezileri ve etkinlik ücretleri, özel ders ve dil destek programları yer almaktadır. Bu kalemler yıllık toplam maliyeti %15-25 oranında artırabilir.

          
          
            

## Eğitim yardımı sunan şirketlerde müzakere yapılabilir mi?

            Evet, özellikle expat paketi sunan şirketlerde eğitim yardımı miktarı müzakere edilebilir. İş görüşmeleri sırasında veya relocation paketini belirlerken okul ücret belgelerini sunarak tavan miktarı artırabilirsiniz. Bazı şirketler belirli okul listesi dahilindeki harcamaları %100 karşılarken diğerleri yalnızca belirli bir tavan uygulamaktadır.


---

## [IB Diploma ile Üniversite Başvurusu: Ülke Ülke Puan Eşikleri 2026](https://www.edualist.com/blog/ib-diploma-universite-basvuru/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/ib-diploma-universite-basvuru/  
**Date:** 2026-09-23

IB sınavları bitti, puan geldi. Sıradaki soru: "Bu puan hangi ülkelerde, hangi üniversitelere yeterli?" Cevap ülkeden ülkeye dramatik biçimde değişiyor. Hollanda'da 28 ile kapı açılırken, Oxbridge için 38 bile zaman zaman yetmiyor.

## IB Puanlama Sistemi

IB Diploma maksimum 45 puan üzerinden hesaplanır: 6 ders × 7 puan = 42 puan + Extended Essay (EE) ve Theory of Knowledge (TOK) bileşenlerinden gelen 3 bonus puan. Diploma için minimum eşik 24 puan. Küresel ortalama yaklaşık 30 puan.

- Maksimum puan: 45 (6 ders × 7 + 3 bonus)
- Diploma eşiği: 24 puan
- Küresel ortalama: ~30 puan
- EE + TOK bonusu: maksimum 3 puan — borderline durumlarda belirleyici
- HL (Higher Level): en az 3 ders HL olmalı; üniversiteler HL notlarına ayrıca bakıyor

Conditional offer: UK üniversiteleri IB sonucu açıklanmadan önce koşullu kabul gönderir (örn. "IB 36, HL Kimya 6"). Temmuz'da bu koşulu karşılarsan yer kesinleşir.

## İngiltere — Oxbridge ve Russell Group

- Oxford / Cambridge: 38–40+ (Tıp/Hukuk/Matematik 40–42; Beşeri Bilimler 38–40)
- Imperial College London, UCL, Edinburgh: 36–38
- King's College London, Durham, Bristol, Warwick: 34–36
- Leeds, Glasgow, Birmingham, Southampton: 32–34
- Exeter, Cardiff, Nottingham, Leicester: 30–32
- Russell Group dışı iyi UK üniversiteleri: 28–30

UK başvurusunda predicted grades Ekim/Aralık'ta UCAS'a giriliyor. Gerçek IB sonucu Temmuz'da açıklanıyor. Offer alıp almadığınızı Nisan-Mayıs'ta, puanı karşılayıp karşılamadığınızı Ağustos'ta öğreniyorsunuz.

## ABD — Top 50 Üniversiteler

IB müfredatı ABD'de zorunlu değil ama güçlü bir profil unsuru. ABD başvurusu IB puanından çok daha geniş bir pakete bakıyor: essay'ler, aktiviteler, öneriler, SAT/ACT.

- Ivy League + MIT, Stanford, University of Chicago: 38–42 ve HL 6–7
- ABD Top 20–50 (Duke, Georgetown, Vanderbilt, UCLA): 34–38
- ABD Top 50–100: 30–34 ile sağlam başvuru
- College credit: HL 6 veya 7 alanlar bazı üniversitelerde kredi kazanabilir

Early Decision / Early Action başvurularında IB sonucu henüz yok — predicted grades ve transcript yeterli.

## Hollanda — Araştırma Üniversiteleri

- TU Delft — Mühendislik / Mimarlık: 33–36 (HL Matematik ve Fizik zorunlu)
- Universiteit van Amsterdam, Leiden, Utrecht: 28–32
- Erasmus Rotterdam, Groningen, Maastricht: 27–30
- Tıp / Diş programları: 36–40 + numerus fixus (ön seçim sistemi)

İngilizce programlar çok geniş (600+), yıllık ücretler AB dışı öğrenciler için 11.000–14.000 €.

## Kanada

- University of Toronto, McGill: 34–38
- UBC Vancouver: 32–36
- McMaster, Queen's, Western, Simon Fraser: 30–34
- Diğer iyi Kanada üniversiteleri: 27–32

## BAE ve Körfez

- NYU Abu Dhabi: 40+ (burs ağırlıklı, çok rekabetçi; HL 7-7-6 ve üstü)
- American University of Sharjah (AUS): 26–30
- American University in Dubai (AUD): 24–28
- Khalifa University, UAEU: 24–28

## Türkiye — YÖK Denklik

IB Diploma, YÖK tarafından yabancı diploma kapsamında tanınıyor.

- Devlet üniversiteleri (Boğaziçi, İTÜ, ODTÜ): YÖS veya SAT/ACT gerekiyor; IB puanı doğrudan kabul için yeterli değil
- Koç, Sabancı, Bilkent: Kendi burslu sınavları veya SAT/ACT; IB 36+ güçlü burs profili
- YÖK denklik belgesi: diploma alındıktan sonra 1–3 ay süren ayrı bir süreç
- Türkçe dil şartı: bazı programlar YÖS içinde Türkçe dil testi istiyor

## Özet Puan Tablosu

| IB Puanı | Açılan Seçenekler |
|---|---|
| 40–45 | Oxbridge, Ivy League, NYU Abu Dhabi, Imperial/UCL |
| 36–39 | Tüm Russell Group, ABD Top 50, Kanada Top 5, Hollanda top |
| 32–35 | Russell Group (çoğu), Hollanda araştırma üniversiteleri, Kanada |
| 28–31 | UK iyi üniversiteler (non-Russell), Hollanda, Kanada, BAE orta |
| 24–27 | UK foundation year, BAE yerel, Türkiye vakıf (SAT ile) |

## HL Konu Seçimi ve EE/TOK Stratejisi

HL konu beklentileri:
- UK Mühendislik / Bilgisayar: HL Matematik + Fizik zorunlu
- UK Tıp / Diş: HL Kimya + Biyoloji (ikisi birden)
- UK Ekonomi / İşletme: HL Matematik güçlü avantaj
- Hollanda: daha esnek; mühendislik HL Matematik istiyor
- ABD: zorunlu HL yok; program uyumu değerlendiriliyor

EE + TOK 3 bonus puan borderline durumlarda belirleyici: 33 puan + 3 bonus = 36'lık conditional offer karşılanır. EE konusunu başvurduğunuz bölümle örtüştürmek (Ekonomi bölümüne başvururken Ekonomi EE seçmek) hem puana hem motivation letter'a güç katar.

## [School Enrolment in Germany: Guide for Turkish Families](https://www.edualist.com/blog/almanya-okul-kayit-rehberi/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/almanya-okul-kayit-rehberi/
**Language:** EN
**Date:** 2026-06-07

Germany's federal structure means each of its 16 states (Bundesländer) runs its own school system. Primary school (Grundschule) runs 4 years (6 in Berlin/Brandenburg). After primary, children are directed into one of four tracks based on academic performance: Gymnasium (university track, years 5–12/13, Abitur exam), Realschule (mid-level, years 5–10), Gesamtschule (comprehensive, all levels internal streaming — most accommodating for expat families), or International School (IB/British/American, no German required, €10,000–€30,000/year).

### German Language Level and School Choice
- A0 (no German): International school or intensive course + Vorbereitungsklasse
- A1–A2 (basic): Gesamtschule with Förderklasse support class
- B1–B2 (intermediate): Realschule or Gesamtschule with tutoring
- C1+ (advanced): All school types including Gymnasium

Vorbereitungsklasse: preparatory class for newly arrived children with limited German. Runs ~1 year, free in state schools.

### City Guide
- Berlin: widest international school network, most expat-flexible, primary school 6 years
- Munich (Bavaria): most academically selective state, high Gymnasium standards
- Hamburg: flexible system, strong international schools, cosmopolitan environment
- Frankfurt: large expat hub, major international school network for finance-sector families

### Enrolment Steps
1. Anmeldung (address registration at Bürgeramt) — mandatory within 14 days, required before school enrolment
2. Assess child's German level — choose school type accordingly
3. Identify catchment school via Schulamt (Schulbezirk system)
4. Visit school and meet principal — bring translator
5. Academic placement assessment (German + maths)
6. Documents: Anmeldungsbestätigung, passport, transcripts (German translation), vaccination record (Masern checked), photo
7. Complete enrolment form via Schulamt or school directly
8. Plan integration: Vorbereitungsklasse + private German lessons + social activities

State schools are completely free. International schools: €10,000–€30,000/year. Check employer Schulkostenbeihilfe (education allowance).

---

## [School Enrolment in France: Guide for Turkish Families](https://www.edualist.com/blog/fransa-okul-kayit-rehberi/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/fransa-okul-kayit-rehberi/
**Language:** EN
**Date:** 2026-06-07

France runs education centrally — same national curriculum regardless of city. Özlem Çimen raised her children in French schools in Yangon (Lycée Français International de Rangoun), Baku (Lycée français de Bakou), Istanbul (Lycée Français Pierre Loti) and Dubai (Lycée Français Jean Mermoz).

### School Stages
- École Maternelle (from age 3) + Primaire (from age 6): free, compulsory from 6
- Collège (ages 11–15): 4-year middle school, ends with Brevet exam
- Lycée (ages 15–18): 3-year high school, Général/Technologique/Professionnel, ends with Baccalauréat
- Lycée Français network: 500+ schools worldwide — major advantage for mobile families

### French Class Numbering (counts down)
6ème (Collège yr 1, age 11) → 5ème → 4ème → 3ème (Brevet) → 2nde (Lycée yr 1) → 1ère → Terminale (Baccalauréat)

### Language Support
UPE2A (Unité Pédagogique pour Élèves Allophones Arrivants): language support for newly arrived foreign students. French is harder to learn quickly than most families expect; children over 14 without French face significant difficulty in state schools. Recommended minimum: A2 before enrolment.

### Enrolment Steps
1. Register at Mairie (town hall) — required first
2. Identify catchment school (carte scolaire — address-based)
3. Apply at Mairie (primary) or Rectorat/DSDEN (secondary)
4. UPE2A language assessment if needed
5. Year group placement — one year back is possible without French
6. Submit documents (justificatif de domicile, titre de séjour, transcripts in French, vaccination record, certificat de radiation)
7. Start intensive French at Alliance Française or private lessons before school starts

State schools: free (small materials ~€100–200/year + lunch €3–5/day). Language adaptation: basic communication 6–9 months; academic French proficiency 3–5 years.

---

## [School Enrolment in Italy: Guide for Turkish Families](https://www.edualist.com/blog/italya-okul-kayit-rehberi/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/italya-okul-kayit-rehberi/
**Language:** EN
**Date:** 2026-06-07

Compulsory education ages 6–16. Academic year starts September; state school enrolment for the following year opens January–February.

### School Stages
- Scuola Primaria (ages 6–11): 5-year primary, free, foreign children enrol directly
- Scuola Secondaria di I Grado (ages 11–14): 3-year middle school, ends with Licenza Media — influences high school choice
- Liceo / Istituto Tecnico (ages 14–19): Liceo Scientifico (sciences), Classico (Latin/Greek/humanities), Linguistico (languages), Artistico (arts). Ends with Maturità for university entry
- International School: IB/British/American, common in Milan and Rome, €10,000–€25,000/year

### Language
Italian state schools teach in Italian. Laboratorio linguistico: language support programme for students with limited Italian. Italian is relatively easy for children to learn — basic adaptation typically within 3–6 months for ages 6–12.

### Enrolment Steps
1. Codice Fiscale: Italian tax number — required for all official processes (Agenzia delle Entrate or Italian consulate)
2. Residenza registration at the Comune (address registration)
3. Identify catchment school via Ufficio Scolastico
4. Pre-register January–February via MIUR online portal
5. Academic placement assessment (Italian + maths)
6. Submit documents in person: Codice Fiscale, Permesso di Soggiorno, Certificato di Residenza, school report (Italian translation), vaccination record, passport photo
7. Enrol in laboratorio linguistico; arrange private tutoring (ripetizioni — widely available, affordable, 2–3 hrs/week recommended)

### Cities
Milan: widest international school network, higher cost of living, large expat community. Rome: rich cultural environment, slightly lower cost, strong state schools.

Turkish diplomas recognised in Italy with apostille + accredited Italian translation. Liceo choice made at age 14. Graduates with Maturità can apply to Italian/EU universities; IB/A-Level graduates have wider international access.

---

## [Netherlands School Enrolment: City and Cost Guide](https://www.edualist.com/blog/hollanda-okul-kayit-rehberi/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/hollanda-okul-kayit-rehberi/
**Language:** EN supplement
**Date:** 2026-09-23

### International English Schools in the Netherlands: City and 2025-26 Fees

| School | City | Curriculum | Annual Fee (€) |
|---|---|---|---|
| International School of The Hague (ISH) | The Hague | IB | 17,000–24,000 |
| American School of The Hague | The Hague | American / IB | 17,000–24,000 |
| British School of Amsterdam | Amsterdam | British / IB | 15,000–22,000 |
| Amsterdam International Community School (AICS) | Amsterdam | IB | 14,000–20,000 |
| International School Rotterdam (IRIS) | Rotterdam | IB | 12,000–18,000 |
| International School Eindhoven (ISE) | Eindhoven | British / IB | 11,000–17,000 |

### City Profiles
- Amsterdam: most cosmopolitan, highest cost of living, competitive housing. AICS + British School of Amsterdam + Amity International School (€14,000–€22,000).
- The Hague: diplomatic and tech hub, highest density of international families. ISH (70+ nationalities) + American School of The Hague (€17,000–€24,000). Waiting lists apply.
- Rotterdam: modern, multicultural, more affordable. IRIS + RISS (€12,000–€18,000).
- Eindhoven: ASML/Philips tech hub. ISE blends IB and British, small classes (€11,000–€17,000).

Dutch state schools are free. TTO (Tweetalig Onderwijs) bilingual state school streams teach half the curriculum in English — no fees. The Hague and Amsterdam international school waiting lists: up to 1–2 years for popular year groups. Apply 12 months before target start date.

ISK (Internationale Schakelklas): 1–2 year bridge programme for newly arrived foreign students; builds Dutch and prepares for mainstream school. Free in state schools.

## [School Enrolment in Canada: Guide for Turkish Families](https://www.edualist.com/blog/kanada-okul-kayit-rehberi/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/kanada-okul-kayit-rehberi/
**Language:** EN
**Date:** 2026-06-07

Canada is a federal country — each province runs its own education system. Most popular provinces for Turkish families: Ontario, British Columbia (BC), Quebec.

### Provincial Systems
- Ontario (TDSB + Peel District): highest concentration of Turkish families. Elementary K–6, Middle 7–8, High 9–12. English and French Immersion streams. Leads to OSSD (Ontario Secondary School Diploma).
- British Columbia (VSB): similar structure, stronger French Immersion emphasis, more nature-focused curriculum. BC Graduation Diploma.
- Quebec: school system largely in French; limited English options; strongest language barrier of any major province.

### Public vs Private
Public school: completely free with PR or eligible work/study permit. ESL/EAL support available in most schools. Class size 25–35. International student visa: ~CAD $10,000–$14,000/year.
Private school: CAD $8,000–$20,000+/year. IB, Cambridge, Montessori options. Smaller classes (15–25). Interview + assessment required.

### Enrolment Steps
1. Proof of Residency (lease or utility bill)
2. SIN (Social Insurance Number) application
3. Birth certificate: notarised English translation
4. Vaccination records: notarised English translation if needed
5. Register via TDSB / Peel / VSB online portal
6. Academic placement assessment
7. Attend school orientation (late August)

Academic year: September first week to late June. January mid-year entry possible at some schools.

### City Guide
- Toronto/GTA (Mississauga, Brampton): Canada's largest Turkish community. Strongest for Islamic schools, Turkish groceries, social networks. TDSB + Peel District. Highest cost of living.
- Vancouver (BC): smaller but cohesive Turkish community. Nature-focused lifestyle, milder climate. Diverse international student population; children adapt quickly.
- Montreal (Quebec): lowest cost of living, but French-dominant school system. Limited English-medium options — evaluate carefully if English-language schooling is priority.

---

## [Third Culture Kids (TCK): Identity, Advantages and Challenges](https://www.edualist.com/blog/ucuncu-kultur-cocugu-tck-rehberi/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/ucuncu-kultur-cocugu-tck-rehberi/
**Language:** EN
**Date:** 2026-06-07

A Third Culture Kid (TCK) is a child who has spent significant developmental years in a culture different from their parents' — and as a result does not feel fully at home in either culture. Term coined by Dr. Ruth Hill Useem (1960s). In cities like Dubai, over 90% of the population consists of expat families.

### TCK Advantages
- Cultural intelligence: cross-cultural understanding develops naturally; multiple perspectives become second nature
- Language ability: early multilingual exposure makes additional language learning significantly easier in adulthood
- Adaptability: constant change builds resilience and fast response to new situations
- Career advantage: global businesses and diplomatic organisations actively seek TCKs; wide international networks from early age

### TCK Challenges
- Identity confusion: "who am I, which culture do I belong to?" — even filling in a nationality field can trigger complex feelings
- Profound loss: each move means losing friends, schools and routines; some TCKs avoid close friendships to pre-empt loss
- Not feeling home anywhere: "I'm Turkish but I live abroad" vs "I'm not fully from here" — sustained between two places
- Re-entry shock: returning to Turkey or passport country triggers a new belonging crisis

### 5 Strategies for TCK Parents
1. Have the identity conversation early — acknowledge both cultures openly; frame it as an advantage
2. Preserve Turkish through active, deliberate effort: Turkish-only day, summer visits, online courses, Turkish media
3. Prepare for re-entry shock before it happens — extended visits (months) far more effective than short trips
4. Model your own adaptation — children mirror parental integration; parents still saying "this isn't for me" after 6 months create the same pattern in their child
5. Build a portable value set — anchor identity in values, not geography

Famous TCKs: Barack Obama, Kobe Bryant, Lupita Nyong'o.

---

## [How to Pass an International School Interview: Guide for Children and Parents](https://www.edualist.com/blog/uluslararasi-okul-mulakatı-nasil-gecilir/)

**URL:** https://www.edualist.com/blog/uluslararasi-okul-mulakatı-nasil-gecilir/
**Language:** EN
**Date:** 2026-06-07

International school admission is a multi-stage process. The school is asking one question throughout: "Are this child and this family right for our community?"

### The 4 Stages
1. Written assessment (Writing + Maths): Grade 3+, 45–60 minutes. Reading comprehension and maths problem-solving.
2. Child interview (30–45 min): child alone with teacher or admissions coordinator. Assesses adaptability, social skills, curiosity — not academic knowledge.
3. Parent interview (30–45 min): open-ended questions on school philosophy, family expectations, educational goals.
4. School tour (optional): also an observation opportunity — how does the child respond to the environment?

### Common Child Interview Questions and Approaches
- Name/age: state clearly + add one natural sentence about current situation
- Favourite activity: be specific ("football" not "games"), explain why
- A difficult time at school: state real challenge + how you resolved it (problem + response = maturity)
- Making new friends: honest self-assessment reads better than performance
- School rules: show maturity — "rules keep everyone safe; if I disagree I ask my teacher"

### Parent Interview: Right and Wrong
Right: explain why this specific school (authentically), highlight child's distinctive qualities, articulate family's educational philosophy, demonstrate research with specific school references.
Wrong: prestige-only motivation, presenting school as back-up, over-focusing on child's weaknesses, disagreeing with school policies, no visible research.

### 30-Day Preparation Plan
- Weeks 1–2: study school's website/social media; curious conversations (not briefings) with child; assess English level
- Week 3: written assessment practice under timed conditions; focus maths on weak areas (fractions, geometry); reading comprehension
- Week 4: mock interview at home — you as interviewer; start easy, increase difficulty; practise eye contact and body language

### Interview Day Checklist
- Leave early — punctuality fully controllable
- Child dressed comfortably and neatly
- Parent energy: calm and positive (children feel parental anxiety directly)
- Note interviewer's name and position
- Reserve questions for the end
- After leaving: don't immediately ask "how did it go?" — give child space first

Results: 2–4 weeks. Continue evaluating other schools during wait. Request feedback on rejection — usually given, always useful.

Common mistakes: teaching rehearsed answers (experienced interviewers detect them immediately); underpreparing for parent interview; going hungry or tired (measurably reduces performance).
